envelope.description: Add LogEditorSection (sc3 DebugSection + project resolution) and append it to DebugConfigurable.sections()

body.title: Add LogEditorSection (sc3 DebugSection + project resolution) and append it to DebugConfigurable.sections()
body.summary: New debug/LogEditorSection.kt implementing sc3 DebugSection (title 'Logs' + off-EDT component()): a read-only category picker (Daemon/Agent from LogCategories.all) + an 'Open in editor' control that resolves a Project via an injectable projectResolver (default = DataManager DataContext CommonDataKeys.PROJECT of the section component, falling back to ProjectManager.getInstance().openProjects.firstOrNull()) and calls LogEditorSurface.openLog; a null resolve renders a clear 'open a project to view logs' line and opens nothing. Then the ONE-LINE edit to ops/DebugConfigurable.kt: sections()=listOf(statusSection(), orphansSection(), mcpSection(), logSection()) + a private logSection()=LogEditorSection() factory (mirrors S005's mcpSection()). The 'Open in editor' button lives in LogEditorSection.kt (NOT DebugConfigurable.kt), so DebugConfigurable's sole-mutating-control (Kill button) source-scan invariant stays true. Per the s3 critique, RESOLVE at build the real DataManager/DataContext accessor for CommonDataKeys.PROJECT (grep existing plugin DataManager/CommonDataKeys usages; if DataContext is not cleanly available inside a Configurable component, fall back to a ProjectManager-only resolver) — the injectable projectResolver seam stays unchanged so the section test uses a fake resolver regardless.
acceptanceChecks: LogEditorSection implements DebugSection, resolves a Project (real resolved DataContext accessor + openProjects fallback, or ProjectManager-only if DataContext is unavailable in a Configurable), opens the log ONLY in an editor tab (not inline), and degrades to a clear line when no project resolves

DebugConfigurable.sections() returns [status, orphans, mcp, log] with the log section appended last; S004/S005 sections + buildBody() unchanged; parent settings page + plugin.xml byte-unchanged (k1/k4)

The section adds no log-mutating control (nothing deletes/rotates/clears a log); the epic's single mutation stays S004's orphan kill (k3); the 'Open in editor' button lives in LogEditorSection.kt, not DebugConfigurable.kt

tests.name: DebugPageTest.sectionsAppendsLogAfterStatusOrphansMcp (+ existing ac2 sole-mutating-control Kill-button assertion still passes)
